label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Ahead of the 15 Oct release date, security testing (MT-1547) and its five subtasks, most of the RMA item-level decision work (MT-1540 in UAT) and the three checkout bugs (MT-1604, MT-1605, MT-1607) reached Ready for Prod on 14 Oct, bringing 26 Marketplace items to Ready for Prod. The live chat widget and platform choice (MT-1577 to MT-1579) moved to UAT, the RFQ and Send a Quote end-to-end tests (MT-1582, MT-1583) closed, and the journey review (MT-1586) is in UAT with 8 of 13 reviews done. 22 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: The site-wide live chat widget (MR-754), the website changes from Raluca Conea's feedback (MR-1341) and six High page bugs reached Ready for Prod on 14 Oct. 116 Marketing items now wait at Ready for Prod, including the 29 Figma fixes and the sitemap fix (MR-1179, MR-1199) waiting since 1 Oct. Kannan Elangovan raised a High bug: email submission fails for every rewards category (MR-1359). 15 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Cășvan Marcel started the Go Live subscription and contract epic (USP-4267) on 14 Oct: four tax stories and the summary-page restyle are in progress, three of them already past their 6 to 13 Oct due dates. Livian Stefan Stan started the VAT and deposit summary line (USP-4366). Two S1 bugs remain open (USP-4231, USP-4204, due 30 Oct); 102 items are past due, 65 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The Teams handoff (UC-22), admin analytics (UC-25) and model selection (UC-26) moved to UAT Testing on 14 Oct, a day before their 15 Oct due date, and end-to-end testing (UC-229) started. Marketplace sign-in (UC-225) is still in progress, and the chatbot bug fixes (UC-233, UC-234) are in Code Review. 27 items are past due, 26 of them untouched since August.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Sarath Chandra started per-app and per-platform monitoring dashboards in Pulse (PULSE-332) on 14 Oct, alongside the status page fixes (PULSE-331). Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: Saurabh Jain closed the agentic communication and lead-journey document (ATLAS-5) on 14 Oct and started building an AI Factory CRM with Gemini and Gmail lead integration (ATLAS-7); Gourav Agnani is validating 33 CRM email role plays (ATLAS-8). The parent CRM MVP item (ATLAS-1) is still To Do with no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: The SAML policy for Azure AD B2C SSO with Rafay (ID-745) and end-to-end testing of MFA, profile and SSO flows (ID-757, ID-759) closed on 14 Oct, and the account deletion hand-back (ID-735) reached UAT. A new S2 bug was raised: a deleted account's session stays active (ID-760). The 6 past-due claims-removal tasks (ID-679 to ID-684) are in production but not closed.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 14 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: The USP pipeline VM (IN-1152), agent registration and scaling (IN-1143) and the UAT Key Vault configuration (IN-1145) closed on 14 Oct. 15 items still sit in BLOCKER status, most held by k.kishore, and 23 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: Test email accounts were removed from Klaviyo (DM-1085) on 14 Oct and the HTTP-to-HTTPS portal link fix (DM-1090) started. Murali G raised a High SEO task: 18 pages are missing H1 tags (DM-1091, due 28 Oct). 25 items are past due, 22 of them untouched in 30 days.
